The customer confirmed that the black PLA samples passed production tests and stated an explicit intent to purchase 500 rolls next month, requesting delivery confirmation by December 15.

Blockers: Need to confirm delivery capability by December 15. Next action: Reply to confirm delivery schedule for 500 rolls by December 15. Evidence confidence: high.
